messages:
maria: quick sync — proposal: a 'Circuit Playbook' annotation in the rollout fallback UX. show which KPI(s) triggered the fallback, the error class, selected degrade mode, and a link to the audit snapshot. want feedback on scope and placement.

ajay: sounds valuable. placement question — rollout detail page or rollout modal preview?

elena: +1. modal preview during canary + a compact badge on the rollout detail (so ops can scan). modal should show a timeline of events. :eyes:

kevin: audit must include the whole decision snapshot (decision_id, inputs, model variant, cache state summary). retention/PD concerns — we should avoid dumping raw prefix text into logs.

sam: API thought: provide /v1/rollouts/{id}/decisions endpoint. example: GET /v1/rollouts/123/decisions?since=2026-03-21 returns list of decision summaries. expand param could return full snapshot.

ops-bot: feature-flag-check: rollout:circuit_playbook -> ON in prod for team-alpha.

maria: rough policy snippet for discussion:
```json
{
  "policy_name": "fallback-circuit-playbook",
  "triggers": [
    {"metric": "p95_latency_ms", "op": ">", "value": 1200, "window_s": 60},
    {"metric": "error_rate", "op": ">", "value": 0.03, "window_s": 60},
    {"metric": "model_timeout", "op": ">=", "value": 1, "window_s": 30}
  ],
  "degrade_mode": "soft_fallback",
  "audit_level": "snapshot_and_meta",
  "sampling": {"phase1_pct": 100, "phase2_pct": 1}
}
```

ajay: UI idea: stacked pills for each trigger (p95, errors, timeouts). color-coded badges, hover = small sparkline + exact value + time. in modal show prioritized trigger and 'why this took precedence'. :sparkles:

elena: telemetry contract: tag metrics with rollout_id, decision_id, trigger_reason, operator_override, and error_class. add trace links to full request replay in trace viewer.

kevin: sampling: agree with 100% for initial breach then down to 1% for long tail. need retention policy for full snapshots (30d?) and aggregated decision telemetry longer (90d). sync with security/compliance.

sam: small API debate: expand=true on list endpoints will be heavy. propose list returns lightweight summaries + decision_id; then GET /v1/decisions/{decision_id}?snapshot=true returns full snapshot. keeps list cheap.

maria: good call. also add operator history (who forced fallback or reverted) to the audit view. must be immutable and show timestamp + ticket ref if any.

ajay: edgecase: overlapping triggers (p95 + error_rate) — show combined view but surface the highest-priority rule first and an explicit "combined" badge. also show 'why not' — why a fallback DID NOT happen when expected (quota, incompatibility, or manual override).

elena: UX nit: in mobile/responsive view collapse the pill list to "3 triggers" and allow expand. keep the important action (revert/ack) visible.

maria: decision: prototype modal + rollout-detail badge + archived snapshot link. API contract: list->summary + decision endpoint for full snapshot. telemetry tags as above. next steps: ajay mock, sam API sketch, kevin retention + compliance check, elena tracing/telemetry plumbing. i'll open tickets and a tiny RFC. tagging owners: @ajay @sam @kevin @elena.

ajay: ACK — will start mock tomorrow and post Figma.

sam: I'll draft the API spec this afternoon (will avoid expand=true).

kevin: will check retention limits with security and report back by EOD.

maria: thanks all — keeping this lightweight for the first pass. if no major blockers I'll PR a console prototype next week. :thumbsup:
